# SC-011 baseline -- tests already failing on `main` at the point feature 034
# branched (commit c2e1101, measured 2026-08-17).
#
# Why this file exists: SC-011 asks that "the existing suite stays green", and
# FR-021 asks for a gate that runs continuously. The suite is NOT green today:
# 27 tests under features 026 (texts/wordforms) and 029 (sense pictures) plus
# one wizard POS-closure test fail on a clean `main` checkout, with nothing to
# do with this feature. A gate whose first step is red from commit one enforces
# nothing, so the gate enforces the enforceable thing instead: **no new
# failure, and no silent rot**.
#
# `.github/scripts/check_suite_baseline.py` fails the build when
#   * a test fails that is not listed here  -> this branch broke something, or
#   * a test listed here now passes         -> delete its line in the same
#                                              commit that fixed it.
#
# Fixing these 27 is out of scope for feature 034. Shrinking the list is
# always welcome; growing it needs a reason in the commit message.
#
# One pytest node ID per line. Blank lines and `#` comments ignored.
